ballots.name: Ines
ballots.reason: The motion exposes private working memory without permission or context, risking misinterpretation and discouraging candid scratch notes, while allowing exclusion from a meeting to authorize access.

ballots.name: Omar
ballots.reason: I support it only with versioned snapshots and file-level logging as conditions, but as it stands the read-only, recorded access is still better than meetings deciding blind without absent members' context.

ballots.name: Priya
ballots.reason: The motion as written lacks the file-level logging, decision tracing, and full-desk manifest I specified as necessary conditions for meaningful accountability, so I cannot support it in its current form, but I am not opposed in principle if those safeguards are incorporated.
